name: club95admin
description: Sistema de gestión de Club 95 (caja, gastos, membresías, panel del dueño)

scripts.vercel-build: node scripts/check-env.mjs && node scripts/prisma-pg.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma --skip-generate && next build
scripts.seed:prod: node scripts/prisma-pg.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && tsx src/seed-cli.ts --random-pins
